KI KHASI KI WAN NANGNO Ka ri Khasi ka long halor ki Wm Khasi Jaintia, ba la ker na shatei, na mihngi bad shathie da ki ri thor Kamrup, Nowgong, Kashar bad ka Shilot (ne Sylhet, ba la khot noh mynta Pakistan mihngi) ; katba na sha sepngi pat la don ki Itim Garo. Ha ka ri Khasi-Jaintia don

shibiin ki syntai Wm, uba jrong tarn na ki u long u Lum Shillong uba don hamar pdeng jong ka ri. Ki wah ruh ki don shibiin, kaba heh tarn na ki ka long ka wah Kupli sha mihngi bad ka Wah Rilang-Kynshi sha sepngi. Ki liim ki long kiba itynnat ; hynrei ka jaka kam seisoh kum ha ri thor. Kumta ki briew kiba shong ha ki liim ki kylla long kiba eh, ba shait, ba khlain bad baksah. Ki ioh ia ka bim da ka jingtrei shitom. Hynrei kim ioh suk kum ki briew kiba shong ha ki ri thor, ha kaba lah ban ioh u khaw u kba had ka dohkha dohpnat kyrhai. Ha ki liim ki hiip rep phan, riewhadem, sohriew bad ki thung ki diengsoh bad ki pai khamtam ha ki ranab lum. KA HIMA MALYNGNGIANG NE MADUR-MASKUT (Kumba 15004650 H. K.) U Mailong Raja bad u Kyllong Raja. Ha kawei ka por la don kawei ka hima kaba donbor shibun ha ri Khasi-Jaintia. Ka la long ka hima barim tarn ba ngi lah ban ioh- sngew ha ki ri Ihm jong ngi. Ka kyrteng jong kata ka hima ka la long ka hima Malyngngiang ne Madur-Maskut. La ju khot i’a ki syiem jong ka ki Syiem-blei. Ki la synshar naduh ri thor Nowgong lyngba ki lum Khasi-Jaintia shaduh Shilot (Sylhet). Ka nongbah jong kane ka Hima Bah ka kyrteng ka law-dai-ja hajan Wahiajer mynta, halor uwei u lum. Kawei ka syiem kaba khlad na kane ka hima ka la leit seng hima ha Mawsynrdm. U Syiem uba nyngkong eh jong ka, ba ngi tip, u la long u Mailong Raja. Une u Syiem u la long uba donbor shibiin bad u bakhraw bor 5 eh ha kaba pyniar hima. Ka hima jong u ka la ialong markhap pud bad ki Syiem Jaintia. U Syiem uba synshar pat ha Jaintia ha kata ka por u la long u Syiem Markuhain. Une u Mailong Raja u la khroh ia u Syiem Markuhain uba shong ha Nartiang ban wan iakren pynbeit ia ka jingiakajia pud hapdeng jong ki sha law-dai-ja. U Syiem Markuhain u la lum ia ka dorbar ki hynniew doloi kiba hapoh jong u ban iapyrkhat shaphang kane. U Doloi Jowai u khang ia u ban leit bad u la ai buit ban phah tang da ki doloi. Hynriew ki doloi ki la Yaleit bad ki la pynriam syiem shynrang ia u Kaia Bandesi bad syiem kynthei ia ka Lipang Rani. Tang shu poi ma ki u Mailong Raja u pynkhreh ka khawai dawai bah bad pyndih buaid ia ki baroh phar. Nangta u

phah pyniap lut pat kdar-dar-dar ia ki baroh. Ka khubor ka la poi sha u Syiem Marku- hain ia kane ka jingjia bad u la khreh phet ; hynrei u Doloi Jowai u khang biang ia u. Ki la iakhreh phraphew ngut ki rang-kieng-wait kieng'Stieh bad la phah la ki sha law-dai-ja bad ki ar ngut ki shakri u Mailong Raja kiba na Jowai. Hamar ba ki dang iabuaid ja hapdeng ka jingkmen bakhraw, kine ki ar ngut ki shakri 6 ki la pyllait tuh I’a ki rang-ialehthma na Jowai kiba la pom lut i'a u shnong u thaw bad wiang ding katba ki dang iathiah mynmiet. U Syiem Malyngngiang uba sah miet ha kata ka pot ha Mawdymmai, u la phet nalor u kulai, tang shu iohi ia ka tdem ding ba ka klang ha shnong jong u. Hynrei ki rang-kieng- wait na Jowai ki la ap lypa ha lynti bad tang u shu poi ma u, ki pom ia u ar dkhot bad rah ia ka khlieh jong u sha Jaintiapur Hadien jong u la mih bujli da uwei u Syiem bashynrang hi sriem kum ma u. Ka kyrteng uta u Syiem ka long u Kyllong Raja. Une u Syiem u la long uba khlain palat. Ym ju lah pyniap duh ia u. La ong, ba mynta i kumba la pyniap ha ka thma, ynda lashai iohi ia u ba u iaid pa i’aid biang kum bam shym lei lei Kane ka la pynlyngngoh shibun ia ki Jaintia. Khatduh khatwai ki la thaw da ka buit kumno ban jop ia u. Ki la pynkhreh da kawei ka thei-samla babhabriew tarn bad bashalak tarn jong ka thaiii Jaintia Ki la suhbuit ia ka ba kan treh ban leit long mahadei ia une u syiem. U Syiem Kyllong Raja de u la ngat ha kane ka buit. U la iashem ia ka ha law'dai-ja ha lew Madur-Maskut bad u la pynlong mahadei ia ka. Ka de, suki suki ka la ioh tuh 7 na u ia ka jingtip shaphang ka jingkhlain bor jong u bad ka la ai jingtip ia

kata sha ki Jaintia. Da kata ka buit la ioh ban pyniap ia u Kyllong Raja katba u dang leit sum ha kawei ka wah hapoh khlaw. Ka hima Madur-Maskut te ka pra bad sapra naduh kata hi ka por artat. 3. U NIANG RAJA KA HIMA JAINTIAPUR. (Kumba 1500 H. K- ei ei). U Niang Raja u long u Syiem Jaintiapur badonnim shibiin. Ym ju lah satia ban pyniap ia u. Ki Syiem Sutnga kiba ha ki ri lum Jaintia ha kata ka por ki la pyrshang ban pyniap ia u, hynrei kim ju lah. Kumta ki la shu thaw noh da ka buit. Ki la wad ar ngut ki samla kiba sian shibtin. Ki la pynbeit ba kin leit shong shakri ha ka Mahadei u Niang Raja. Ka Mahadei ruh ka la pdiang ia ki kum ki shakri iing. Kine ki shakri ki la trei bha katta katta ia ka kam. Ki la lah ban kem ia ka jingieit bad jingshaniah jong ka Mahadei. Ha kawei ka sngi ki la kylli twad buit ia ka hangno ka bor u tnga jong ka ka don. Ka de ba ka shaniah ia ki ka la iathuh. Ka iathuh ba u shait leit sum marwei sha kawei ka jaka bakynjah. Ym 8 ju don mano mano ba tip hangno kata ka don. Dei hangta ba u buh noh la ki tiar ki tar ialeh- thma, khlem nongap. Ki Mawbynaa ba ha Jaintiapui. 9 Kita ki samla de !ci la khroh ia ka Mahadei ban iathuh hangno kata ka jaka ka don. Kaba pli ka Mahadei bashida jinglong ka la kum iathuh sor bad ka la khang iap khang im ia ki ban nym leit jan shata. Bad ki la kular de ban leh kumta ia ka. Ynda ha kawei ka sngi, sor ki la ialeit iapar tuh ban leit shata sha ka jaka ba u sum. U tang shu iohi ia ki, u rynsied pum hapoh um bad ngam thiaw artat hangta. Kumta mar mar ki wan iathuh ha ki Syiem Sutnga. Ki Syiem Sutnga de ki la iakmen bad ki

la leit dokhol ia ka hima jong u kaba sha ri thor. Naduh kata ka por ka hima Jaintiapur ka h^p hapoh ka jingsynshar ki Syiem ri-liim kiba na Sutnga. 4. U MARKUHAIN BAD U SAJAR NANGLI JONG KA HIMA JAINTIAPUR (Kumba 15164532) Don uwei u Syiem Jaintiapur bakhrawbor uba kyrteng u Syiem Markuhain. Hapoh jong u la don hynhiew ngut ki doloi. One u la long u Syiem Samla ba dang marwei bad u la wad Mahadei. U iohi ba don kawei ka khtin kynthei u Sajar Nangli baiabiang kyrdan bad u. U la phah da la ki briew jong u ban twad jingmut na u Sajar Nangh. Hynrei u Sajar 10 Nangli um mon ban ai la ka khun kynthei bamarwei jong u ha u Syiem. U Syiem u la pynmih hukum ban «hna kawei ka nan ha Nartiang. U Sajar Nangli bad la ki paid babun jong u, u la pyndep hapdeng khyndiat sngi. Kane ka la pynsngewbha i'a u Syiem Markuhain. U la khreh ka khawai ka dawai kaba khraw ban ai burom i’a u Sajar Nangli bad ia ki paid jong u. Nangta u khroh ia u Sajar Nangli ban sahmiet, hynrei um treh. Nangta u Syiem u la thap ban shu phah knieh jubor ia ka khun kynthei jong u. U Sajar Nangli nangta tang iohsngew ia kata u la khreh phet nob. U la lum la u paid babiin ban iafeit ryngkat bad u. Kine ki la iateh jutang ban nym iehnoh lyndet lyndang ia u. Ki la iatih nan kawei tang mar shisien tih da la ki tdong ryntieh. la kata ka nan la khot haduh mynta ka Biar u Sajar. Ka jingbiin jong uta u paid, la ong, ka la long kaba khraw shibiin. Don uwei u synrei baki buh pyngkiang lynti ha ka lynti iaid jong ki. Da ka jing'iaiuh u paid babdn da la ki pohjat jong ki-, uta u synrei u la lut artat khoit. U Sajar Nangli bad u paid babiin u ialeit shaphang sepngi na Raliang bad hana, ki leit seng hima pat ha Khatsawphra. 5.

U BORSINGH SYIEM KA HIMA SOHRA (Kumba 1731-1770^ U Borsingh Syiem u long u Syiem Sohra uba khrawnam. Ha ka por ka jinglong syiem jong u, u Syiem Borkusain bad ka para jong u ka Kong Rimai na ka hima Jaintiapur ki shah set ha Nongkrem ha ki Syiem Shillong. U myntri rangbah jong ki uba kyrteng u Lyngskor Potiphas u la leit khroh ia u Borsingh Syiem na Sohra ban pyllait ia u. U Borsingh Syiem de u ai buit ia u kumno ban iakynduh bad u Syiem Borkusain. U bthah ia u ban riam pukir bad ban leit rwai dkhar ha Nongkrem. Tang shu iakynduh ia u Syiem Borkusain un iatehkular katno un ai lada pyllait ia u. U Potiphas de u la leit bad ioh ktien ba un ai katto katne ki shnong ha ri dkhar sha u Syiem Sohra. Kumta u Borsingh Syiem u la phah biang ban leit sha Nongkrem kumba mynshuwa. Tangba ha kane shisien un da pyndih buaid ia ki nongset byndi jong ki Syiem (kiba la shah set hapoh sem sniang). U ong artat ba ki tang shu lait kin ialeh ban ryngkang sha ka pud u Syiem Sohra uba dang ap bad la ki paid iapom jong u. 12 U Potiphas uba la leit bad ki katto katne ki lok de u la leh, kumba la bthah. La pyndih- buaid ia ki nongap. Ki la thlieh ia ka jyng- khang. La pynkit ia ki Syiem Jaintiapur sha ka pud Sohra bad la ialam ia ki sha Sohra. Ha Sohra ki iashong shipor. Hynrei ki kwah ban leit phai noh sha la shnong. Kumta ki la ialeit ryngkat bad u Borsingh Syiem. La ialam ruh ia u Piah Lyngskor na ka hima Sohra ban iasynran lang ia u Syiem Sohra. Ha ka jaka ban ai ia kita ki jaka, u Syiem Borkusain u shet kylla pynban. U iawer leit behmrad ban iashong mar la ka lieng. Ia u Borsingh Syiem la pynpoi sha Shilot bad la set ha ka kut u jamindar Sujlar. la lade pat u wan phai sha la shnong

ha Jaintiapur. U Piah Lyngskor u la sngewlyngngoh balei ba wan phai shnong tang u Syiem Borkusain bad ba u Borsingh Syiem um wan phai. Kane ka la pynkhuslai jingmut ia u. U la leit wad ia u Syiem Borkusain ban kylli balei, hynrei um man lah iashem satia. Kumta u leit iathuh noh ha u Potiphas. U Potiphas de u leit kylli na u Syiem Borkusain balei u Borsingh Syiem um wan phai. Hangta u sngewthuh ia ka jingthmu runar u Syiem Borkusain. U wan iathuh ha u 13 Piah Lyngskor bad ong ia u ba un leit noh shuwa sha Sohra. Ia lade pat u pynkhih tik ban ialeh pyrshah ia u Syiem Borkusain. U Syiem Borkusain u tip ia ka bor u Potiphas ha ka hima. Kumta u iasuh buit bad ka tnga jong u ban pyniap ia u, bad la ioh pyniap hamar ba u dang iohthiah mynmiet. Uwei u briew na Wahlong u leit khaii pateng sha Shilot. U leit kum iohi ia u briew uba kum u Borsin^ Syiem ba u dih um hapoh ka kut u jamindar Sujlar. Mar mar u wan iathuh sha Sohra ia kaba u iohi baroh. Ki myntri Sohra de ki leit khmih bad lap shisha kumta. Ki la thaw buit |?an pyllait ia u nangta, bad u la lait. U Syiem u la wan poi sha Sohra hadien lai snem bad iathuh lut ia ki jingjia baroh ha ki myntri had ka dorbar. U Borsingh Syiem u mut ban ialehthma bad u Syiem Borkusain- Hynrei u Morsing Syiem na ka jait Syiem Sohra u shah pynbim tyngka ha u Syiem Borkusain bad u iashah noh bad u lem bad katto katne ki myritri. Kumta u Borsingh Syiem u shu kynriah noh na Sohra ban leit seng hima noh ha Mawsmai. 6. U TIROT SINGH KA HIMA KHATSAWPHRA (Kumba 1814-1334) U Tirot Singh u long u Syiem Khatsaw- phra, ha ka por ka jingwan kiew ki Phareng sha ri lum Khasi. U la long uba tbit ban siat khnam naduh dang khynnah. Ha ka por une u Syiem, u

Iskat Sahep (David Scott) u long u Sahep rangbah ha Gaubati. Une u sahep u kwah pom surok kulai na Gauhati sha Shilot lyngba ka hima Nongkhlaw. Kumta u la pyni'adei lok bad u Tirot Singh, namar u Tirot Singh u iawan iaieit teng teng sha Borduar, ka jaka jong u ba hajan Gauhati. La khot sngewbha i'a u Iskat Sahep sha ka hima Nongkhlaw ban pynshai ia kata ha ka dorbar. Ka dorbar hadien ka jingpasaidnia bad jingiapyni nia bajur ka la iarai ban shah. Tang shu ioh bor kumta, u Iskat Sahep u pynkiew shipai ha Nongkhlaw. U phah ar ngut ki sahep rangbah hapoh iong u. U pynshna iing dak bangla. U pynkiew ki nongshna surok na Shilot bad Gauhati. 15 Kine ki leh kulmar ha iew ha hat, ha jaka tong um bad khlaw thohdieng. Don ruh kiba ong ba ka Sorkar Bahadur jong ki kan sa wan jop bad luh top la ki ri liim kumba leh sha thor. Kane ka la sawa sha ki shkor ki myntri Nongkhlaw. Ki myntri Nongkhlaw ki la iadorbar harieh harieh bad ki hdp jingmut ban khang noh la kane ka jingpom surok. Kumta sdang da ka thma ir. La pyniap ia uwei u sahep Lepton Bed- dingfield, katba uwei pat u lait noh. Ka Phet Syiem. ka kmie u Tirot Singh, ka iaieit ia sngewbha bad u Iskat Sahep. Kam kwah ba un lap. Ka la ai buit ia u ban phet la dang step phyrngab sha Sohra. Ki khla-wait ka Nongkhlaw ki la beh sia sia ia u, hynrei kitn lap shuh. La ong ba u Iskat Sahep u pashat paisa nalor jrong u kulai katba u nang phet ; bad katba ki nang ialut por ka iatim paisa ha lynti, u la nang lait noh.' La pdiang sngewbha ia u da u Syiem Sohra. Hynrei u Tirot Singh u pynkhih ia ki hima Khasi baroh ban beh noh ia ki Phareng. Bad la don ruh katto katne na sha thor Assam kiba la iarap ia u ha ka ban beh noh ia ki Phareng. 16 Hynrei

da ka jingpynbdm tyngka Ja uwei na ki Syiem Khasi ka Sorkar Phareng ka la lah ban tip la ka- jaka rich u Tirot Singh bad ka la kem ia u, hadien ka jingialeh kaba la neh saw snem. Ki rangbah nongTapam badonnicn ha kata ka pof ki la long u Mon Bhut, u Lorshon Jarain bad u Khein Kongor, bad ka thma ka la nang i’aid wat hadien ba la kem ia u Tirot Singh. La leit ialam ia u Tirot Singh sha Dakka bad la set phatok ia u hangta. U la iap noh ha phatok ha ka 29 tarik u Lber 1834. U lah ka iap kum u Syiem ha iing byndi ban ia ka im kum u mraw ha ka khet Khatsawphra. Hadien jong u ki hima Khasi ter shi ter ki la nang iaid sha ka kti ka Sorkar Phareng. 7. U RAJA DAKHOR SINGH KA HIMA SHILLONG (1903-1919) Ka Hima Shillong ka la long ka hima kaba idr shibiin. La ngeit ba ka non^eng banyng- kong eh jong kane ka hima ka la long ka Pah Syntiew. Kane ka la long ka kynthei ba la shu ioh kem napoh ka ktem Marai, ba hajan u 17 L'im Shillong, da kaba pah ne khtoh da u syntiew. Ka dei ma ka ruh kaba ser^ nyng" kong ia ka shad ha ri Khasi. U Syiem Dakhor Singh. Ki Syiem kiba khtaw bor ki synshar tef shi ter ia kane ka hima. Ha kawei ka por ka 18 hima Shillong ka la t4r naduh ki them ka wah Brama ha Kamrup haduh ki them ka wah Surma ha Shilot. Hadien hadien ia ka hima Shillong la pynpait sha ki ar hima. Kawei ka jait Sviem oa iapait ka seng ia ka hima Mylliem kaba mynta Kawei pat ka jait syiem ba la shah thang la biinsien ka seng hima noh ha Nong- kseh. Hadien hadien ka pynkynriah noh ia ka nongbah banyngkong eh na Nongkseh sha Nongkrem bad na Nongkrem pat sa sha Sndit. U Syiem bapawnim bad bakhatduh eh na kine ki Syiem Nongkrem u la

long u Syiem Dakhor Singh. Une u la long syiem hadien ka jinglap u Syiem Klur Sngi. Ha ka por une u syiem ki Phareng ki la wan kiew sha ri liim Khasi. U Syiem Dakhor u pynkynriah ia ka iing- sAd iingsunon na liim Smit sha madan Smit, kaba sah haduh mynta U tei ruh ka iing- dorbar bad kawei ka Ung dak bangla. U long uba nang bastad bad uba nang ban ri la ka burom bad ia ka burom ka hima. U la synshar da ka mynsiem babeit bahok bad da ka bor ka buit baroh ban pynkiew ia ka jingnang jipgstad bad jingioh jingkot jong u khiln u hajar. Baroh kat kiba la ithuh bad iadei kam bad u ki pyrto Ta ka jinglong babha bad jingdon-akor jong u. Ka Sorkar Phareng hi ka la sngew fiiewkor shlbdn eh ia ki kam 19 babha baroh ba u leh.
